reasoning: E1 carries the earlier condition: from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right. The Book 24 development appears only in E5, an agent_proposed Working Book element, so it is proposal rather than record. The link from that condition to the development is stated in no cited item, and no cited item says what the labour means for the lineage; E3 is an agent inference. E1 also describes a rota that already carries households' share, which the 'rather than by a schedule' wording does not account for.
quote: Book 24 is where the Long Return's labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule.
alternative_reading: Read as a labelled proposal (basis proposed, horizon proposed_book), the Book 24 development is a creative option, not an error. What fails is the unstated link from the Book 20 condition and the unsupported consequence for the lineage. E5, the only carrier of the development, is agent_proposed.
would_settle: An author-stated or established item that Book 24 is where people first meet the labour gap, and one linking the Book 20 arrangement to a change in the lineage's meaning of labour.
creative_room: Open: Book 24 as the first point where people rather than a schedule meet the gap, and a lineage whose meaning of labour shifts. Treat the development, the lineage change and any causal link to the Book 20 arrangement as proposals, not record, until an established item carries them.

clauses.text: The earlier condition is carried by the cited items.
clauses.note: E1 states that from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right. The claim does not name which condition it means, so this carries only that arrangement.

clauses.text: Book 24 is where the labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule.
clauses.note: Only E5 states this, and E5 is agent_proposed. E1 names no Book 24 and no gap, and describes a rota that already carries households' share.

clauses.text: It changes what the labour means for the lineage.
clauses.note: No cited item states a change in what labour means for the lineage. E3, the only lineage-stake text, is labelled an agent inference.

defensible_possibility: That Book 24 is where people, not a schedule, first meet the labour gap remains a defensible creative proposal if it is labelled as one. The change in what labour means for the lineage is open as a further proposal.
